interval_ownership.owned_snapshot: borrowed terminal state to owned LiveSnapshot
interval_ownership.daemon_publication: subscriber history lookup, snapshot, and queue admission
interval_ownership.wire_materialize: LiveSnapshot/update batch to one bounded protocol event
interval_ownership.client_apply: protocol update validation and snapshot mutation
interval_ownership.frame_prepare: display snapshot plus full/incremental SnapshotFrame preparation
interval_ownership.draw_commit: SHM acquisition, composition/copy, damage, attach, and wl_surface.commit
interval_ownership.graphical_input: development-only graphical client input queued after committed revisions
interval_ownership.pane_commit: one body-free pane transaction associated with the surface commit boundary
interval_ownership.frame_callback: commit-to-compositor callback wait; not presentation latency
interval_ownership.tab_switch: client-local tab activation and bounded state replacement
interval_ownership.window_event: transaction-free Wayland configure or surface output-enter/output-leave callback count
